mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.couple_id, d.user_id, d.diary_date, d.mood, d.content, d.images, d.created_at, d.updated_at, u.nickname AS author FROM diary d LEFT JOIN user u ON d.user_id = u.id WHERE d.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diary (couple_id, user_id, diary_date, mood, content, images) VALUES (#{coupleId}, #{userId}, #{diaryDate}, #{mood}, #{content}, #{images})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM diary WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
